newsitem.title: USA: SAC Technologies completes initial public offer.
newsitem.headline: SAC Technologies completes initial public offer.

text.p: SAC Technologies Inc said Wednesday it closed an initial public offer of 1.1 million common shares at a price of $6 each.
The stock is being traded on the Nasdaq Bulletin Board under the symbol SACM, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to repay notes and for general corporate purposes in addition to paying for research and product development, the company said.
SAC Technologies develops systems capable of identifying individuals through automated fingerprint analysis.
Its shares were off 3/4 Wednesday afternoon at 7-1/4.
